Triage notes (initial):

- KV cache hit-rate dropped sharply for large-seq requests; suspect cache invalidation cascade after recent kernel rollout at 17:30 PT.
- Retry amplification: client library retries (backoff too aggressive) + server-side queueing created a positive feedback loop.

Immediate mitigations performed (18:30–18:35 PT):
- Rolled back kernel rollout to last known-good at 17:29 PT (partial mitigation; error rate reduced ~40%).
- Applied per-tenant soft concurrency cap increase and enabled t2-small fallback for OrchidPay checkout route.
- Blacklisted a noisy internal batch job that coincidentally hit the same model endpoint.

Remaining tasks (next 2–6h):
- Full KV cache rebuild for OrchidPay tenant (estimate 45–60m).
- Hardening retry guards in the serving runtime (disable retry on 5xx for specific flows).
- Postmortem artifacts: collect kernel logs and timeline (I attached the runbook draft and capacity calc).
